checks: Exact named tests in native-commands.json; paired source syntax
cost: With p parsed and r realized nodes and B lemma bytes, greedy matching O(p*r*B); two structural passes same pair bound. apply O(r+p+payload bytes) memory/time excluding deep clones. Realizer scans all F frames per clause O(F^2) plus recursive entity expansion, membership logs, punctuation cost and payload clones; recursive depth is unbounded.
description: F::of and E::of project parser frames/entities excluding source text/how except nominal flag. Realizer emits NP and verb structures, tracks seen ids, honors links/TAM/off flags then punctuates. encode_with greedily aligns pre-pairs, lemma+coarse, lemma, two structural passes; one Insert or Take per parsed node. apply maps realized heads through inverse Take indices before explicit patches.

Realizer emits NP and verb structures, tracks seen ids, honors links/TAM/off flags then punctuates. encode_with greedily aligns pre-pairs, lemma+coarse, lemma, two structural passes; one Insert or Take per parsed node. apply maps realized heads through inverse Take indices before explicit patches.
inverse: Given realized tree r and encoder script s, apply(r,s) is a reconstruction witness for original parsed tree. Fixed output alone admits many frame/link/TAM states and discarded realizer nodes; scripts with missing or duplicate Take origins need not identify unique antecedents.

Realization never reads Ent.text as surface oracle. A damaged script with absent Take origin yields an empty Dep placeholder, not successful recovery of unavailable source text. Normal realization does not imply semantic equivalence.
limitations: No annotator/model loading, live corpus, full suite, teacher, GPU or persistent-learning evidence. No executable percentage surrogate: categorical codecs/effects need a useful metric before future caps 1/2/5/10%.
